posts.community: Embassy REIT: Is this "Blackstone" promoted REIT is real diamond?
posts.text: The core challenge with the Energy Infrastructure Trust (EIT) (formerly India Infrastructure Trust) is a classic valuation problem: the market prices it as a finite-life, amortizing annuity rather than a perpetual equity stock. Its primary underlying asset, Pipeline Infrastructure Limited (PIL), operates the ~1,480 km East-West natural gas pipeline from Kakinada to Bharuch. It features a headline distribution yield, but this yield is optically inflated because it includes a return of capital over time .
